articles.title: Beyond disgusting: Actor Ayesha Khan slams moral policing in Jamui assault case
articles.summary: Ayesha Khan condemned the alleged assault of two minors in Jamui and questioned the justification of moral policing. Her remarks came amid outrage over the circulated video and a wider debate over harassment in the name of culture.
